posts.title: All Shades of Silence
posts.description: I was listening to Katharsis again recently and passed by their short split release with Antaeus , released in 2009 and right before the end of the band’s glorious journey in black metal. It was out in February that year, a few months prior to the amazing final EP, Fourth Reich , when the curtains dropped for one of the genre’s most hard-hitting entities at the time.
